battle.name: 魏滅北涼之戰
battle.brief: 北魏太武帝拓跋焘於太延四年五月出師平城，沿河套西行；七月兵至姑臧，涼王沮渠牧犍率眾出降，河西五郡盡入於魏。此役勝負不在野戰，而在撞車、雲梯與斷糧之間。卡面的科林斯青銅盔未曾上陣，它代表全正面封閉頭盔的族譜：河西兜鍪、面甲同樣以封閉換防護，戴者只能靠隊形活命。

kit.name: 科林斯青銅盔
kit.history: 全正面開眼的青銅盔。看得見的代價是：戴它的人只能靠隊形活。

countries: 魏滅北涼之戰是一場十六國末期、北魏與河西割據政權之間的戰爭。交戰方是北魏太武帝拓跋燾所率的北魏中央軍，以及以姑臧為都的北涼沮渠氏政權。北魏是拓跋鮮卑建立的北方王國，一九八年代取代北燕，控制平城與代北；拓跋燾於四二四年即位後推行胡漢雙軌的統治，軍隊以拓跋騎兵、漢人步兵與歸附的氐、羌、鮮卑部眾編組，徵發與屯田並重，河西之役是其最後一次大規模西進。北涼則由盧水胡沮渠氏建立，沮渠蒙遜於四○一年逐走段氏西涼而據有河西，四一二年遷都姑臧，疆域涵蓋武威、張掖、酒泉、敦煌等郡，並控制通往西域的商路與祁連山南北的牧場。涼以漢地士人治理州郡、以胡族控弦為軍，與魏共享同一條綠洲補給線，因此本役的實質是水源與糧倉之爭。
countriesEn: The War of Wei's Destruction of Northern Liang was a conflict fought in the late period of the Sixteen Kingdoms between the state of Northern Wei and a breakaway regime holding the Hexi corridor. The two belligerents were the central army of Northern Wei under Emperor Taiwu Tuoba Tao, and the Juqu-clan state of Northern Liang with its capital at Guzang. Northern Wei was the northern kingdom founded by the Xianbei Tuoba; it replaced Northern Yan in the late 390s and held Pingcheng and the plain of northern Dai. After Tuoba Tao took the throne in 424 he governed through a dual Xianbei and Han structure, and his army was composed of Tuoba cavalry, Han infantry, and enrolled Xianbei, Di and Qiang groups, with conscription and tuntian agriculture pursued together; the Hexi campaign was the last great westward drive of that state. Northern Liang, for its part, had been founded by the Lushui Hu Juqu clan: Juqu Mengxun expelled the Duan regime of Western Liang in 401 and took the Hexi corridor, moving the capital to Guzang in 412. Its territory covered the commanderies of Wuwei, Zhangye, Jiuquan and Dunhuang, and it held the trade road to the Western Regions as well as the pastures north and south of the Qilian range. Liang governed its commanderies through Han literati and fielded its army from tribal bowmen, and it drew on the same oasis supply line as Wei, which made this war in substance a contest for water and grain.
people: 北魏方面，太武帝拓跋燾是全場主導者，年近七旬仍統軍西征，親至姑臧受降，顯示北魏對河西志在必得。司徒皇太子拓跋晃、平原王拓跋濬皆從征：前者藉此熟悉河西軍政與屯田，後者初涉軍旅。謀臣清河人崔浩掌文書與軍略之議，太延年間曾奏請修國史，說明魏廷已把河西納入長期的編纂與治理計畫。北魏的騎將與攻城各隊則由太武帝分命，未見大將獨斷一役之跡。涼方主事者為涼王沮渠牧犍，沮渠蒙遜之子，四三三年嗣位，在位六年守成而無所建樹；其母孟氏出自敦煌，為涼宗室之女，母子同入平城後仍受供給與厚待。牧犍之弟沮渠安周奉命守敦煌，力屈後走吐谷渾，圖謀復國，終為魏軍追誅。河西各郡的守將多由漢人士族出任，其中亦有據城死守、拒而不降者。
peopleEn: On the Northern Wei side, Emperor Taiwu Tuoba Tao was the director of the whole operation. Though close to seventy years old he still led the army west in person and entered Guzang to receive the surrender, which shows that Wei regarded Hexi as something that had to be taken. Grand Prince and heir apparent Tuoba Huang, then Prince of Pingyuan Tuoba Jun, both accompanied the expedition: the former used it to master military and civil administration in Hexi and in the tuntian system, the latter took his first taste of the field. The strategist Cui Hao of the Qinghe commandery handled documents and the discussion of military plans, and in the Ta yan years he petitioned for the compilation of the national history, which shows that the Wei court already thought of Hexi in terms of long-term record keeping and government. The Wei cavalry and the assault teams were assigned by the emperor himself; no single general commanded the operation alone. On the Liang side the man in charge was the Liang king Juqu Mujian, son of Juqu Mengxun, who had succeeded to the throne in 433 and in six years of rule achieved nothing beyond holding what he inherited. His mother, Lady Meng of Dunhuang, was a woman of the Liang ruling house, and after mother and son were taken to Pingcheng they continued to be provided for and treated with courtesy. Mujian's brother Juqu Anzhou was left to hold Dunhuang; when his resistance failed he fled to Tuyuhun seeking to restore the kingdom, and was eventually hunted down and executed by Wei troops. The commanders of the Hexi commanderies were for the most part Han literati, and some of them held their cities obstinately to the end rather than surrendering.
kits: 本役的實際裝備重心是弓騎與攻城器械。北魏騎兵以角筋木弓配箭，長柄用方天畫戟與長槊，鎧甲以鐵札甲為主，頭戴兜鍪並加護領，戰馬多無重甲，靠騎射、速度與隊形取勝；步兵以長矛、刀、盾與弩為主，攻城則備撞車、雲梯、蒙衝，並配合臨城築土與掘地，處處顯示魏軍把戰役重心放在消耗而非強攻。北涼軍隊以涼州漢地鄉兵為骨幹，混編氐、羌、盧水胡騎兵，善用標槍、弓箭與長柄刀，倚賴姑臧、敦煌等堅城與祁連山雪水灌溉的屯田為久戰之資。卡面的科林斯青銅盔並未在此役出現，它所代表的全正面封閉青銅盔傳統，在漢晉的兜鍪與面甲上留有同源的痕跡：用封閉視野與聽覺換取正面防護，戴盔者只能靠隊形與旗鼓口令行動。河西墓葬所出魏晉鍪形與鎮墓陶俑，說明這條工藝譜系到四三九年仍在延續；而更早的東漢末曹操高陵出土的甲士俑與鎧馬俑，則是武裝騎兵這條路徑在時間上的前哨。
kitsEn: The real weight of equipment in this campaign lay in missile cavalry and siege gear. Wei cavalry shot with composite bows of horn and sinew on wooden staves, used the fangtian painted halberd and the long spear as their long weapons, wore iron lamellar armour, and carried a helmet with a neck guard; their horses were seldom armoured, and they won by archery, speed and formation. Their foot soldiers fought with long spears, sabres, shields and crossbows, while for the siege they brought battering rams, scaling ladders and covered rams, combining the assault with earthworks thrown up against the walls and tunnels driven beneath them, which shows that Wei meant to spend the enemy down rather than break him in one rush. Liang's army had the local Han militia of Liangzhou as its backbone, mixed with Di, Qiang and Lushui Hu riders; it was skilled with javelins, bows and long-handled blades, and it relied on the strongholds of Guzang and Dunhuang and on the tuntian irrigated by Qilian snowmelt for the means to endure a long siege. The Corinthian bronze helmet of the card was never present in this campaign. What it stands for is the tradition of the fully closed bronze helm, and traces of the same line run through the helmets and face masks of the Han and Jin periods: exchanging restricted vision and hearing for frontal protection, so that the wearer could only stay alive through formation and through drum and banner signals. Helmet forms and tomb figurines recovered from Hexi burials show that this craft lineage was still being carried on in 439, and the armoured soldier figurines and armoured horse from the late Eastern Han tomb of Cao Cao near Anyang are an earlier beacon on the same road towards armoured cavalry.
tactics: 北魏的戰術是長距離機動作戰加攻堅消耗。出師之前，魏廷先以外交與切斷外援為先手，拉攏河西氐、羌諸部，並斷絕涼與柔然、吐谷渾之間的往來，使姑臧陷於孤立；大軍自平城出發，沿黃河經五原、靈州、沃野南行，過河後沿祁連山北麓的綠洲西進，避開戈壁缺水路段，途中以屯田與徵發解決糧秣，前鋒以騎兵警戒兩翼，遇涼軍出城即以箭雨與遮蔽拉開距離，消耗其精騎，同時不放下攻城器械的準備。到姑臧城下，魏軍不急於強攻，先築長圍、絕其汲道與糧道，再以撞車、雲梯及穿地進逼，步步為營，把守軍困在城裏。涼軍的對應是據城固守、出城騎戰與派使乞援三線並行；外線既斷，城中糧盡，沮渠牧犍終於出降。全戰的關鍵，可說是對水與糧的控制，以及把距離與隊形管好，而非任何單一武器的性能。
tacticsEn: Wei's method was a long march of manoeuvre followed by a siege of attrition. Before the army marched, the court moved first on the diplomatic side and by cutting off outside help: it drew the Di and Qiang groups of Hexi over and severed Liang's contacts with Rouran and Tuyuhun, so that Guzang was left isolated. The main force left Pingcheng, followed the Yellow River south through Wuyuan, Lingzhou and Woye, and after crossing the river turned west along the oases at the northern foot of the Qilian range, avoiding the waterless stretches of the Gobi, and solved the problem of grain and fodder on the way through tuntian fields and requisitions. The advance guard scouted both wings with cavalry; whenever Liang troops rode out they were met with arrow showers and cover, drawn off and worn down, while the siege train was never let go. Before Guzang, Wei did not rush the walls. It built a long encircling line, cut the wells and the grain road, and then advanced by battering ram, scaling ladder and tunnel, moving forward step by step and trapping the garrison inside the city. Liang's answer was to hold the city, to fight in the open and to send envoys for help, all at once; with the outside line already cut and the grain in the city running out, Juqu Mujian finally came out and surrendered. The real key of the campaign was control of water and grain and the management of distance and formation, not the performance of any single weapon.
data: 年表方面：四三九年為北魏太武帝太延四年；涼王沮渠蒙遜卒於四三三年，牧犍嗣位至此年凡六年。距離方面，平城（今山西大同）至姑臧（今甘肅武威）直線約九百五十公里，至敦煌約一千六百公里；自平城出師至兵抵姑臧，一般記為三月左右行程，與七月前後進抵涼州的記載相合。兵力方面，正史未載魏軍與涼軍的確切人數；一般視此役為魏廷傾全線兵力的一次遠征，兵數以萬計，涼軍除守軍外，可集結的騎兵為數千至萬餘之譜。器物與物資方面，姑臧為河西數十年積累的府庫所在，馬匹、穀帛、鐵器與兵器數量可觀；魏軍克涼後得馬得糧，河西由割據的軍區一變為北魏的屯田與軍鎮。敦煌莫高窟第二八五窟留有西涼承元二年（四一○年）與大魏承明年號（四七○年代）兩則題記，為西涼與北魏先後控制河西提供了直接的斷代標記。
dataEn: On the chronology: 439 is the fourth year of the Ta yan era of Northern Wei's Emperor Taiwu. The Liang king Juqu Mengxun had died in 433, so Mujian had ruled for six years by the time of the campaign. On distances: the straight line from Pingcheng, modern Datong in Shanxi, to Guzang, modern Wuwei in Gansu, is about 950 kilometres, and to Dunhuang about 1,600 kilometres; the march from Pingcheng to the walls of Guzang is generally reckoned at about three months, which fits the record of the army reaching Liangzhou in the seventh month. On strength: the official histories give no exact numbers for either army. The campaign is generally taken to be a dispatch of Wei's entire front, so the numbers run into the tens of thousands, while the riders Liang could gather beyond its garrisons number somewhere between several thousand and rather more than ten thousand. On materiel: Guzang was the seat of a treasury accumulated over decades of Hexi, with horses, grain and silk, iron and weapons in quantity; after taking it Wei gained both horses and grain, and Hexi changed in a single stroke from a disputed war zone into a region of tuntian colonies and military towns of the Wei state. Two inscriptions in Cave 285 at the Mogao Grottoes carry the date of the second year of the Cheng yuan era of Western Liang, 410, and the Cheng ming reign title of Great Wei from the 470s, giving a direct chronological marker for the succession of Western Liang and Northern Wei over Hexi.
cause: 打這場仗的原因有四層。第一是北魏統一的必然要求：經四二九年滅赫連夏、四三○年代平定北燕，北方只剩河西這一塊割據，而涼據姑臧扼住通往西域的咽喉，不取河西，柔然與西域諸國就多一個進出的孔道。第二是沮渠氏政權自身的困境：蒙遜死後，牧犍守成，涼的漢地士族與胡族部眾之間的矛盾未獲化解，宗主地位不穩，涼又屢捲入與柔然、南朝宋的角力，元氣大損。第三是地緣與補給的考慮：河西走廊的綠洲與屯田是魏軍西征的補給前提，也是魏廷眼中可以自給自足的戰略縱深，兵鋒及時抵達就能就地取糧，不必仰賴千里之外的平城。第四是太武帝的個人判斷：他清楚涼是硬骨頭，唯有以全線兵力一次壓上，用攻城的耐性換取政治上的徹底勝利。
causeEn: There were four layers of reason for the war. First, unification was a necessity for Northern Wei: with the defeat of the Heshun Xia state in 429 and the reduction of Northern Yan in the 430s, only the Hexi block remained independent in the north, and while Liang held Guzang it kept the throat of the road to the Western Regions; unless Hexi was taken, Rouran and the states of the west would keep a door through which they could come and go. Second, the Juqu regime was itself in trouble: after Mengxun's death Mujian merely held what he had inherited, the tension between Han literati and tribal groups in Liang was not settled, the overlordship of the Hexi was unsteady, and Liang was repeatedly drawn into contests with Rouran and with the southern Song court, which drained it. Third, geography and supply argued their own case: the oases and tuntian fields of the Hexi corridor were the precondition for feeding a western expedition, and in the Wei court's view a strategic depth that could feed itself; an army arriving in time could draw its grain on the spot instead of depending on Pingcheng a thousand li away. Fourth was the personal judgement of the Taiwu emperor: he knew Liang would be a stubborn opponent, and that only by throwing his whole front into one stroke, and paying for patience in the siege, could he buy a complete political victory.
impact: 這場戰爭的直接後果是北涼政權滅亡，河西走廊自武威至敦煌全線歸入北魏版圖，北魏因而在拓跋燾手上完成北方統一，與南朝劉宋形成南北對峙，疆域由漠南草原直抵西域門戶。深一層看，涼的漢地士人與胡族統治集團在河西經營的半農半牧秩序被北魏的軍鎮與屯田體系接續，涼州由獨立政權的地盤變成北魏西部的屏障與賦稅基地，敦煌、張掖、酒泉的屯田與絲路東段的中轉功能被保留並擴大。其後數十年，魏在河西設西海、廣西二郡約束吐谷渾，與西域諸國恢復直接往來，高昌亦曾一度隸魏，直至四六○年麴氏自立。制度上，這場征服把北涼的漢地治理經驗與北魏的拓跋軍事體系揉在一起，孕育出隋唐之前的西北軍鎮格局；而河西的儒學與譯經傳統在易主後也未中斷，莫高窟第二八五窟在四七○年代留下大魏承明的年號題記，正是僧俗往來照舊的見證。
impactEn: The immediate consequence was the end of the Northern Liang state and the passage of the whole Hexi corridor, from Wuwei to Dunhuang, into the territory of Northern Wei. Under Tuoba Tao that completed Wei's unification of the north, set Wei and the southern Liu Song court face to face, and stretched the empire from the steppe of the southern desert right up to the gateway of the Western Regions. Looking deeper, the half-farming, half-pastoral order that Han literati and tribal rulers had built in Hexi was taken over by the Wei system of military towns and tuntian colonies; Liangzhou changed from the ground of an independent state into a shield and a revenue base for the western frontier of Wei, and the tuntian colonies of Dunhuang, Zhangye and Jiuquan, along with the relay function of the eastern stretch of the silk road, were preserved and enlarged. In the decades that followed, Wei set up the commanderies of Xihai and Guangxi in Hexi to hold Tuyuhun in check, resumed direct contact with the states of the Western Regions, and kept Gaochang under its rule for a time until the Qu clan made itself independent in 460. Institutionally, this conquest blended the Han administrative experience of Northern Liang with the Tuoba military system of Northern Wei and produced the pattern of northwestern military towns that would last into the Sui and Tang; and the scholarly and translation traditions of Hexi were not broken by the change of masters, as the Cheng ming reign-title inscription of the 470s in Cave 285 of the Mogao Grottoes testifies to monks and laymen keeping their old intercourse.
result: 結果是涼王沮渠牧犍開城出降，魏軍入姑臧，收其府庫圖籍，赦免郡兵將士、仍授舊職，河西各郡改隸北魏涼州牧統轄；沮渠牧犍封河西王，與母孟氏一同被遷往平城居住，接受供給與監視；其弟沮渠安周走吐谷渾圖謀復國，終被追誅，沮渠氏的政權與軍事傳統至此斷裂。軍事上，涼軍主力並非在野戰中被擊潰，而是耗盡於城下的糧水與援兵斷絕；政治上，拓跋燾以一次遠征換來北方最後一個對手的消失，其後數年即啟動南下，卻因江南水網與用兵失度而止步瓜步。河西的門戶被打開，絲路東段重歸單一王朝控制，之後數百年的西北格局，從北魏的軍鎮到唐代的河西節度，都以四三九年這一年為起點重新排列。
resultEn: The result was that the Liang king Juqu Mujian opened the gates and surrendered. The Wei army entered Guzang, took over the treasuries and the records, pardoned the soldiers and officers of the commanderies and gave them back their posts, and the commanderies of Hexi were placed under the governor of Liangzhou of the Northern Wei. Juqu Mujian was made Prince of Hexi and was moved with his mother Lady Meng to live at Pingcheng, where he was provided for and watched; his brother Juqu Anzhou fled to Tuyuhun to restore the kingdom and was hunted down and killed, and with him the polity and the military tradition of the Juqu house came to an end. Militarily the main body of the Liang army was not broken in open field but used up in the city for want of grain and water and with its relief cut off; politically Tuoba Tao had bought the disappearance of the last rival in the north with a single expedition, and within a few years he moved south, only to be stopped at Guapiu by the water country of the Yangtze and by his own misdirection of the campaign. The gateway to the west was opened, the eastern stretch of the silk road returned to the control of a single dynasty, and the northwestern order of the following centuries, from the Wei military towns to the Tang circuits of Hexi, was rearranged from the year 439 onward.
